other_conditions: Applicant must be a female registered construction worker
The construction worker must have been continuously registered for at least one year
The family can avail the assistance only twice, with only one claim per marriage
The registered construction worker must have no dues payable to the Board
The worker’s daughter must have attained the legal age for marriage as prescribed by law
The worker’s daughter must not be an employee in government or quasi‑government agencies
Application must be submitted within 6 months of the marriage
benefits_summary: A one‑time grant of ₹50,000 is provided to meet the marriage expenses of the female registered construction worker or up to two of her daughters.
